food.en: Different countries have very different traditional food.
food.cn: 不同国家有非常不同的传统食物。

rice.en: A bowl of rice with vegetables makes a simple lunch.
rice.cn: 一碗米饭配蔬菜就是简单的午餐。

noodle.en: On my birthday, Mum always cooks long noodles for me.
noodle.cn: 我生日时妈妈总给我做长面条。

bread.en: I eat a piece of bread and an egg every morning.
bread.cn: 我每天早上吃一片面包和一个鸡蛋。

meat.en: We should not eat too much meat — vegetables are also important.
meat.cn: 我们不该吃太多肉——蔬菜也很重要。

vegetable.en: Fresh vegetables help us grow strong and healthy.
vegetable.cn: 新鲜蔬菜帮我们茁壮健康。

tasty.en: Grandma's dumplings are the tastiest food in the world.
tasty.cn: 奶奶的饺子是世上最好吃的食物。

sweet.en: These cherries are so sweet and juicy.
